summary: Anthropic announced a multi-year alliance with DXC Technology to train tens of thousands of Claude-certified engineers who will embed Claude into DXC's managed IT systems for banks, airlines, insurers and government agencies, building on DXC's internal use of Claude to build its OASIS orchestration platform.

mechanisms.reason: A large services firm is rolling out Claude-powered agentic workflows across its own operations and dozens of enterprise customers, implying a broad increase in deployed inference surfaces.
mechanisms.quote: DXC will train tens of thousands of Claude-certified forward-deployed engineers (FDEs)—engineers embedded directly inside customer organizations—to bring Claude into the systems DXC operates for the world’s largest banks, airlines, insurers, manufacturers, and government agencies.
